items.title: Muse AI: 12 Advanced Tricks After the Basics — Spaces and Cloud Tasks in Order
items.zh_title: Muse AI：掌握基础后的 12 个进阶技巧，Spaces 与云端任务井井有条
items.zh_oneliner: 这条短视频介绍了 Muse 的 12 个进阶用法，重点讲如何把 Spaces 和云端任务安排得井井有条，适合已经上手的用户继续深挖。
items.en_oneliner: This short video walks through 12 advanced Muse tricks, focusing on keeping Spaces and cloud tasks organized — a good next step once you've got the basics down.

items.title: Meta Stock Rises Even as Report Flags a Troubling Flaw in Muse AI Agent - TipRanks
items.zh_title: Meta 股价上涨，尽管报告指出 Muse AI 智能体存在令人担忧的缺陷
items.zh_oneliner: TipRanks 报道称，Meta 股价走高之际，一份报告点出了 Muse AI 智能体的一处隐患，提醒投资者在看好之余也要留意产品风险。
items.en_oneliner: TipRanks reports that Meta's stock climbed even as a report flagged a worrying flaw in the Muse AI agent, a reminder to weigh product risks alongside the optimism.
